capabilities: Highlight the active note and its parent folder path in the File Explorer
Fade unrelated files and folders instead of hiding them
Keep direct outgoing links and backlinks unfaded in the folder tree
Auto-expand folders containing the active note and its related notes
Toggle focus mode via ribbon icon or commands
extras: Bilingual English/Chinese README; requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later; supports desktop and mobile; states it makes no network requests and can also be installed via BRAT.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's native File Explorer quickly becomes a wall of text. Path Focus Explorer brings spotlight focus to your sidebar
problem: In large vaults with deep folder hierarchies, the native File Explorer becomes a wall of text and it is hard to see where the current note sits and which notes relate to it.
summary: Highlights the active note's full folder path and direct links in the File Explorer while fading unrelated files.
